title: 次第
summary: 次第 is a noun meaning "next in sequence", which explains as soon as, depends on, and gradually.

blocks.text: A dictionary lists many meanings for 次第: "as soon as", "depending on", "gradually", "circumstances". They all grow from one idea. The kanji say it: 次 is "next" and 第 is the mark of an ordinal. So **次第 = the next thing in the sequence**, a noun that attaches to another noun.
As soon as: the い-stem + 次第
The い-stem of a verb is a noun, so it can sit before 次第. What follows is "the next thing in the sequence".

blocks.jp: 駅に着き次第、電話します。
blocks.en: As soon as I arrive at the station, I will call.

blocks.jp: 準備ができ次第、出発する。
blocks.en: We'll leave as soon as the preparations are done.

blocks.text: If the next thing follows **directly** from the noun, the result depends on it. It works like the compound nouns 腕時計 and 砂時計, where the first noun tells you about the second: here the noun tells you what the outcome hangs on.

blocks.jp: 明日の予定は天気次第だ。
blocks.en: Tomorrow's plan depends on the weather.

blocks.jp: あとはあなた次第です。
blocks.en: The rest is up to you.

blocks.text: The same pattern also means "according to", and it can take に or で to modify a verb.

blocks.jp: 値段は品物次第で違う。
blocks.en: The price differs according to the goods.

blocks.text: A noun used as an adverb. 次第 on its own, with nothing modifying it, becomes "step by step".

blocks.jp: 空は次第に暗くなった。

blocks.text: Not every 次第 + に is that adverb. In 身分次第に暮らす above, the modifier is the whole 身分次第. And 手当たり次第 means "whatever comes to hand".

blocks.jp: 手当たり次第に本を読む。
blocks.en: (I) read whatever books come to hand.

items: The **い-stem** + 次第 = as soon as.
**Noun** + 次第 = depends on, up to.

questions.instruction: What is the one idea behind 次第?
options: The next thing in the sequence
questions.note: 次 is next and 第 marks an ordinal.

questions.instruction: Fill the gap
questions.prompt: 仕事が終わり＿＿＿、帰ります。
questions.note: い-stem + 次第 means as soon as.
questions.en: I'll go home as soon as work finishes.

questions.instruction: Fill the gap
questions.prompt: 旅行に行くかどうかはお金＿＿＿だ。
questions.note: Noun + 次第 means it depends on that noun.
questions.en: Whether we go on the trip depends on money.

questions.instruction: Fill the gap
questions.note: 次第に modifies a verb, and 強く is the adverb form.

questions.instruction: Which part of the verb comes before 次第 in the "as soon as" use?
questions.note: The い-stem is a noun, so it can sit before 次第.

questions.instruction: Which one means "depends on"?
questions.note: Noun + 次第: the result depends on the noun.

questions.instruction: What does 次第 mean here?
questions.prompt: 料金は人数次第で違う。
options: According to the number of people
As soon as the people come
questions.note: Noun + 次第 can mean "according to".
questions.en: The fee differs according to the number of people.

questions.instruction: What does 次第 mean here?
options: As soon as the teacher comes
questions.note: Noun + 次第 means depends on.

questions.instruction: True or false?
questions.prompt: 天気次第 means "depending on the weather".
questions.note: Noun + 次第: the result depends on the noun.
questions.en: 天気次第: depending on the weather.

questions.instruction: Which one means "it is up to you"?
questions.note: Noun + 次第 with nothing between them.

questions.instruction: Which sentence means "It gradually got cold"?
questions.note: 次第に is the adverb: step by step.

questions.instruction: Tap the word that means "as soon as"
questions.note: い-stem でき + 次第.
questions.en: Let's eat as soon as the food is ready.

questions.instruction: Tap the adverb that means "gradually"
questions.note: 次第に on its own means step by step.
questions.en: It became winter, and it gradually got cold.

questions.instruction: Tap the noun that decides the result
questions.note: Noun + 次第: the plan depends on the weather.
questions.en: This trip depends on the weather.

questions.instruction: Build the sentence
questions.prompt: I will call as soon as I get home.
questions.note: い-stem 帰り + 次第.
questions.en: I will call as soon as I get home.

questions.instruction: Build the sentence
questions.prompt: As soon as the rain stops, we'll go out.
questions.note: い-stem やみ + 次第.
questions.en: As soon as the rain stops, we'll go out.

questions.instruction: Build the sentence
questions.note: 次第に is an adverb that modifies なった.

questions.instruction: Build the sentence
questions.prompt: The rest depends on the teacher.
questions.note: Noun + 次第 means depends on.
questions.en: The rest depends on the teacher.

questions.instruction: Which sentence means "as soon as I get the money, I'll buy it"?
options: お金が入る次第、買います
お金が入って次第、買います
お金が入らない次第、買います
お金が入り次第、買います
questions.note: い-stem 入り + 次第.

questions.instruction: What do 次 and 第 mean?
options: Next, and the mark of an ordinal
questions.note: 次 is next and 第 marks an ordinal.

questions.instruction: What does 手当たり次第 mean?
options: As soon as I hit it
questions.note: 次第 here means 'in the order it comes': whatever is at hand.

questions.instruction: Build the sentence
questions.prompt: I'll decide tomorrow according to the weather.
questions.note: Noun + 次第 + で: according to the weather.
questions.en: I'll decide tomorrow according to the weather.
